title: Recipe Hub Category Taxonomy
description: Structured browsing taxonomy for Recipe Hub. Categories are grouped by user intent while recipe metadata such as cuisine, course, difficulty and time remain available for filters and future collections.

groups.description: Explore recipes by culinary tradition, country, and regional cooking style.
